• To disable the GPS tracker on a Bird scooter, follow these steps:

1. Open the Bird app on your phone and log in to your account.
2. Tap on the "Account" or "Settings" icon (usually represented by a gear or a person icon) in the top right corner of the screen.
3. Scroll down to the "Scooter" or "Vehicle" section and select it.
4. Look for the "GPS" or "Location Services" option and toggle it off.
5. If you're unable to find the GPS option, try searching for "GPS" or "Location Services" in the search bar at the top of the screen.
6. If you're still unable to find the GPS option, try restarting the app and logging back in.
7. If the GPS option is still not available, try contacting Bird customer support for assistance.

Alternatively, you can also try the following:

1. Go to your phone's settings app and select "Location Services" or "GPS".
2. Look for the Bird app and toggle off the location services for the app.
3. If you're using an iPhone, go to Settings > Location Services > Bird and toggle off the location services.
4. If you're using an Android device, go to Settings > Location > Location services > Bird and toggle off the location services.

Note: Disabling the GPS tracker may affect the functionality of the Bird app and your ability to locate your scooter.
